chunks: Aḥmad ibn ʿAbdūn informed me, from ʿAlī ibn Muḥammad ibn al-Zubayr, from ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥasan, from Muḥammad ibn al-Walīd, from Yūnus ibn Yaʿqūb, from Abī ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام, who said:
Concerning a woman for whom the time of salat entered while she was in a state of taharah, then she delayed the salat until she menstruated, he said: She makes it up when she becomes pure.

key_terms.تَقْضِي: she performs the missed prayer as qada'
key_terms.طَاهِرَةٌ: ritually pure, not menstruating at that time
key_terms.طَهُرَتْ: she became pure after menstruation ended
key_terms.وَقْتُ الصَّلَاةِ: the time of the prescribed salat

ai.seo_question: If a woman delays salat after its time begins and then menstruates, must she make up that prayer after becoming pure?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about a woman whose salat time begins while she is in a state of taharah, but who delays the prayer until menstruation begins. It states that she must perform qada' of that salat after she becomes pure, since the prayer time had entered while she was able to perform it.
